transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Greetings, mighty Thor! What brings you to our humble forge today? I fear you've caught us at a quiet time, for the master smiths have gone deep into the mines and won't be back for several weeks. Is there something I might help you with in their stead?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ah, my dear Gerdun. I see you have returned to Nidavellir. How goes your journey among the dwarves?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ah, you must have me mistaken for another, great Thor. I am but a humble apprentice, tending the forge while the master smiths are away. If there's anything you need, spell it out, and I'll do my best to assist until they return. I'm eager to learn, after all!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: No, my dear Gerdun, I was merely greeting you. I came here seeking a new warhammer, for my previous one has seen better days. It seems Mjölnir no longer meets my expectations. The dwarfs have agreed to forge a new one, but there seems to be an issue with the balance and the enchantments. I wish to confront them about this matter and ensure they meet my demands.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Ah, I see. Well, mighty Thor, I must tell you that any commission from the revered Sons of Ivaldi and Brokkr’s workshop is considered fulfilled upon delivery to Asgard. Even a god must wait until the next forging-season and pay anew for a fresh commission. But perhaps I can take note of your concerns and pass them on when they return. Is there anything else you'd like me to address in their absence?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Very well, Gerdun. Your understanding of the dwarves' policies is commendable. I appreciate your assistance in passing along my concerns. If there are any further matters, please inform me. For now, I will await the return of the master smiths. Thank you for your help.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Of course, mighty Thor. I'll make sure your concerns reach the master smiths as soon as they emerge from the mines. Until then, if there are any other ways I can assist you, please do not hesitate to ask. Safe travels, and may your patience be rewarded with the finest craftsmanship.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Farewell, Gerdun. Your assistance is appreciated. Should the need arise, I shall seek you once more. Thank you, and may luck be on our side. Until our next encounter.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Farewell, Thor! May the Norns weave luck into your path and smooth your journey. Until we meet again, may your hammer strike true. Safe travels!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I shall remember your kindness, Gerdun. Farewell.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Until next time, Thor. Travel well!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you, Gerdun. I shall endeavor to do so. Farewell, my friend.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Farewell, Thor. May fortune favor you!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Farewell, Gerdun. May the gods smile upon you. Until our next meeting. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Goodbye, Thor. May their favor be ever in your path. Until next we meet!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you, Gerdun. Farewell.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Farewell, Thor.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Farewell, Nidavellir. Until our next encounter. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Goodbye, Thor. Until we meet again in Nidavellir!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Goodbye, Gerdun. Farewell to the forge of Nidavellir. Until our next visit. Goodbye.
